workload_lunch_minutes_007.answer: 30 (minimum of 60 when students are not present)
workload_lunch_minutes_007.evidence: The regular working day for teachers shall be seven and one-half (7 1/2) hours which shall include a minimum of thirty (30) minutes for lunch. Lunch on days when students are not present shall be a minimum of one (1) hour.

workload_meetings_limits_008.evidence: Faculty meetings shall be held within the teacher's regular working day.

workload_nonteaching_duties_009.evidence: Teachers will not be required to ride buses or perform custodial functions.
